context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 精力/病棟/宿命/神父/駐留/標識/国政/故意

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、精力的に逃走を続けておりました。
lines.en: The suspect continued to flee persistently.
lines.style: Measured official statement. Even tempo, no inflection on the facts themselves. Weight rests at period's edge, not on any one word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者、病棟で、回復に努めておられるんですね。
lines.en: The victim is working toward recovery in the ward.
lines.style: Gentle inquiry. Slightly softer attack. Thoughtful pause before 'recovery' — respect for the seriousness. Warm but not intrusive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。警察官の宿命として、危険、覚悟しております。
lines.en: Yes. As a police officer, I've accepted the risks that come with this work.
lines.style: Quiet acceptance. Flat delivery on the duty itself — no dramatics, no apology. Slight firmness beneath, the kind that comes from lived conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 神父さん、被害者家族の心の支えに、なっておられますね。
lines.en: The priest has become a real support for the victim's family, hasn't he.
lines.style: Observational, almost to himself. Slight tilt of admiration. Not a question despite the shape — noting something he's witnessed and respects.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。米軍駐留地周辺、捜査、慎重に進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're proceeding carefully with the investigation around the US military facility area.
lines.style: Back to procedure. Slight tightening on the scope of the work — 'carefully' carries the weight of complication. Professional distance restored.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 交通標識、改ざん、増えているそうですね、世間で。
lines.en: Traffic sign tampering seems to be on the rise lately.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Softer attack. Slightly curious tilt — he's noticing patterns, not accusing. Room for the officer to respond or not.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。国政の影響、警察活動にも、及びますね。
lines.en: Yes. National political currents reach into police operations as well.
lines.style: A single steady note. Weariness held just beneath the surface but not performed. The tone of someone who sees the larger machinery at work and doesn't hide from it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 故意の事件と過失、線引き、難しいですよね、本件も。
lines.en: The line between intentional crime and negligence — it's difficult to draw, isn't it. Especially in a case like this.
lines.style: Slower pace. Genuine wrestling with complexity. Slight exhale at the end — not looking for an answer so much as thinking aloud with someone he trusts.
